correctness.rationale: With degree d=(n−1)a+b and cross block aJ+(b−a)I, the constant-on-parts modes have eigenvalues 0,2d and the symmetric and antisymmetric zero-sum modes have eigenvalues na,(n−2)a+2b. For n≥3, a>0, b≥0 the latter are strictly interior and coincide only at b=a, including no accidental collision at b=0. Symmetric PBH excludes exactly the nonzero eigenvectors vanishing on the selected coordinates. Off resonance, zero-sum (x,±x) vectors vanish there iff x is supported on untouched matched indices; such a nonzero vector exists iff at least two are untouched. At resonance the merged eigenspace is E⊕E, giving the same zero-sum test on each class separately. The valid sets are nonempty, so neither constant mode obstructs them. Counting at most one empty pair or at most one omission per class gives the claimed polynomials, minimum counts and multiplicities. Independent Bernoulli vertex actuation gives a binomial count of empty pairs with probability (1−p)², or independent binomial counts of omissions per class with probability 1−p. Their Poisson limits give both profiles with the stated coefficients. Inspected the recorded finite rank and enumeration support without executing uploaded code; the general result follows from the spectral proof, not finite modular ranks.
